BiblicalUsage: Zebah was one of the two kings of Midian who led the invasion Gideon defeated, and his name is tied to the other king, Zalmunna. Gideon pursued them past Succoth and Penuel, caught them, and put them to death, and the Psalmist later names Zebah and Zalmunna among the enemies God sweeps away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zebah's story is a warning to every power that rises against God's people: the chase may be long, but it ends. Gideon was faint yet pursuing, and that is the picture of faith I hold onto.
RelatedPeople: Zebah, King of Midian; Gideon; Zalmunna, King of Midian
